title: GOOD: RFC 2046 boundary termination check prevents false-positive splits
description: mime_parser.rs implements is_boundary_terminated() which checks that the character immediately after the boundary string is LWSP, CR, LF, end-of-buffer, or the close-delimiter dash — rejecting lines like --boundaryFOO that share only a prefix. This is the correct RFC 2046 §5.1.1 interpretation and is tested with an explicit oracle (RFC 2046 §5.1.1 BNF). Most MIME parsers get this wrong by using simple prefix matching, which causes body text to be incorrectly consumed as a boundary delimiter. The test_boundary_prefix_false_positive test verifies this with the exact RFC clause cited.
